info.title: Min Strøm Consumer API
info.summary: Read-only access to your own energy data with Min Strøm Plus.
info.description: Use a bearer key created in iOS. Seven read-only operations; excludes app credential management and Enterprise endpoints. Examples are synthetic. Interval calendars use Europe/Copenhagen while timestamps are UTC. See the guides for sparse data, normalized ranges, quotas, and security.

get.description: Discover your addresses and configured capabilities. Names and region may be null. No provider-health check; an account without addresses returns an empty data array.

200.description: Successful response. Sparse/empty data is valid; 200 does not guarantee a complete period.

get.description: Read consumption using the app's existing source selection and best-effort loading. Hourly requests have a 366-local-day cap; day/month/year requests have a five-local-year cap, after normalization.

200.description: Successful response. Sparse/empty data is valid; 200 does not guarantee a complete period.

get.description: Read exported energy for a configured solar-export meter. Hourly requests have a 366-local-day cap; day/month/year requests have a five-local-year cap, after normalization.

200.description: Successful response. Sparse/empty data is valid; 200 does not guarantee a complete period.

get.description: Danish calculated costs, including VAT and allocated fixed fees. Uses native app aggregates; the cap is 366 local days after normalization at every aggregation. Results need not reconstruct a complete bill.

200.description: Successful response. Sparse/empty data is valid; 200 does not guarantee a complete period.

get.description: Danish calculated net revenue, excluding VAT and after fixed fees. Uses native app aggregates; the cap is 366 local days after normalization at every aggregation.

200.description: Successful response. Sparse/empty data is valid; 200 does not guarantee a complete period.

get.description: Confirmed prices only; never substitutes forecasts. Known components are returned even when other billing inputs are missing. No fixed fees. Hour: 366 local days; fifteenMinutes: 90 local days, after normalization.

200.description: Successful response. Sparse/empty data is valid; 200 does not guarantee a complete period.

get.description: All stored future hourly forecasts from max(current hour, latest confirmed hour + one hour). No confirmed rows means start at the current hour. No earlier-gap backfilling and no fixed seven-day horizon. DK1, DK2, SE3, SE4 only. Rejects all query parameters; supported regions with no remaining forecasts return empty data.

200.description: Successful response. Sparse/empty data is valid; 200 does not guarantee a complete period.

ConsumerBearer.description: Opaque Consumer API key created in iOS. Plus required. Store securely; not an Enterprise credential.

Timestamp.description: UTC instant encoded with Z. Interval ends are exclusive.

TimeZone.description: Interval calendar, currently Europe/Copenhagen for all regions. Timestamps remain UTC.

Currency.description: Currency of amounts and per-kWh rates; no conversion.

consumption.description: Configured support for consumption; not a provider-health or completeness guarantee.

solarExport.description: Configured support for solarExport; not a provider-health or completeness guarantee.

consumptionCosts.description: Configured support for consumptionCosts; not a provider-health or completeness guarantee.

solarExportRevenue.description: Configured support for solarExportRevenue; not a provider-health or completeness guarantee.

prices.description: Configured support for prices; not a provider-health or completeness guarantee.

forecastPrices.description: Configured support for forecastPrices; not a provider-health or completeness guarantee.

id.description: Owned address ID for series paths; not a meter or external registry ID.

gridOperatorName.description: Display name from persisted grid information; no live lookup.

supplierName.description: Supplier on the currently active matching agreement, or null.

energyKWh.description: Returned energy in kWh. Missing rows are not zero.

isEstimate.description: Estimated data flag; false does not certify completeness.

totalPricePerKWh.description: (totalCost - fixedFeesForInterval) / energyKWh, in currency/kWh. Null at zero energy. Not rounded to three decimals.

totalCost.description: Calculated cost including fixed fees and VAT; not a complete-bill guarantee.

totalPricePerKWh.description: (netRevenue + fixedFeesForInterval) / energyKWh, in currency/kWh. Null at zero energy. Not rounded to three decimals.

netRevenue.description: Calculated net revenue after fixed fees, excluding VAT. May be negative.

totalPricePerKWh.description: Known composed price including VAT, in currency/kWh, rounded to three decimals without guaranteed trailing zeros. Excludes fixed fees; unknown billing components may be missing.

variableChargesPerKWh.description: Known variable charge component including VAT, in currency/kWh, rounded to three decimals. Null when unavailable. Non-Danish addresses do not load Danish charges.

reason.description: Safe human-readable explanation; use errorCode for program logic.

errorCode.description: Stable code guaranteed inside Consumer routes. Unmatched URLs use general backend handling.

data.description: Ascending sparse rows; empty is valid. Gaps are not zero readings.

AddressId.name: addressId
AddressId.description: Owned address ID returned by List addresses.

From.name: from
From.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 start with Z or numeric offset. Fractions accepted. Expanded outward to the interval.

To.name: to
To.description: Exclusive RFC 3339 end after from. Expands outward unless aligned. Caps apply after expansion.

Resolution.name: resolution
Resolution.description: Confirmed historical price resolution. Hour has a 366-day cap; fifteenMinutes has 90 days after normalization.

RequestId.description: Response UUID for support. Never send your key.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the latest reset among exhausted windows; present on 429.

LimitMinute.description: Configured minute limit; present after quota evaluation.

RemainingMinute.description: Remaining minute attempts; present after quota evaluation.

ResetMinute.description: Minute reset as Unix seconds (UTC fixed window); present after quota evaluation.

LimitDay.description: Configured day limit; present after quota evaluation.

RemainingDay.description: Remaining day attempts; present after quota evaluation.

ResetDay.description: Day reset as Unix seconds (UTC fixed window); present after quota evaluation.

BadRequest.description: Invalid parameters, invalid_range, or range_too_large. Capability checks precede range validation.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, unknown, revoked or mismatched key; credential_expired only after verifying an expired key.

Forbidden.description: Inactive Plus (plus_required), or a distinct access denial (forbidden).

example.reason: An active Min Strøm Plus subscription is required.

NotFound.description: Unknown, deleted, invalid, or other-user address ID; indistinguishable.

UnavailableFeature.description: Requested capability is not configured or supported.

example.reason: This feature is unavailable for this address.

RateLimited.description: Minute or daily quota exhausted. Denied attempts count too; honor Retry-After.

example.reason: The request limit has been exceeded.

InternalError.description: Sanitized unexpected error, including unclassifiable legacy errors.

UpstreamUnavailable.description: Identifiable provider failure. Some best-effort failures yield sparse/empty 200 responses instead.

example.reason: The data provider is temporarily unavailable.

ServiceUnavailable.description: entitlement_unavailable or rate_limiter_unavailable. Retry later, not necessarily entitlement loss.

example.reason: Min Strøm Plus subscription verification is unavailable.
